During the holiday season, Toni and Bri decide to shake up their mundane world by creating new identities to crash the Christmas parties from the shop's confidential invitations.
When a runaway reindeer threatens their annual Christmas play, a dysfunctional couple must work together to save the holidays for the town and each other.
A loving couple shares the story of how they met and fell in love when their daughter's boyfriend comes to meet them for the first time at Christmas.
Prompted by their youngest granddaughter, four generations of women celebrate Christmas and family in the style of the 40s, 60s, 90s and today.
The Brenner brothers are back and putting on a holiday pageant for young Thomas, while trying to cope with life's curveballs, including their mum's new boyfriend.
Looking for inspiration, singer songwriter Maggie travels home and finds a spark with app developer Archer, who's trying to repair his relationship with his sister.
In order to keep Elizabeth employed at her real estate business, her soon-to-be father-in-law sends her back to her hometown to persuade an ex-boyfriend to sell his ski resort.
Three generations on Cherry Lane experience life-changing Christmases, from a mistaken address leading to a live TV special, to a family facing their last holiday together.

Princess Victoria is ready for a change of pace. Looking to decompress, she decides to take a vacation to Peaceful Pines Ranch in Montana.
